data.one_liner: TextField widget to search and select values from a static list or future.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TextField widget that allows users to search and select values from either a local list or an asynchronous Future list. It supports custom item labels, object selection, and callback functions for retrieved values.
use_when: You need a text field with autocomplete or search-and-select capabilities.
You want to populate search results from a static list or an asynchronous Future.
avoid_when: You need complex form validation frameworks or form builders.
You require advanced dropdown menu features handled by official Material Menu widgets.
strengths: Supports both static lists and Future-based asynchronous lists.
Allows selecting full objects with a custom label property via getSelectedValue.
weaknesses: Issues must be reported via email rather than a standard platform tracker based on the provided text.
Limited to string labels or objects with a label property.
